glosses: harmony (pleasing combination of elements, or arrangement of sounds)

examples.en: They lived in harmony with each other.

examples.text: Dobbiamo imparare a vivere in armonia con la natura.
examples.en: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.

examples.text: La gente di questo villaggio vive in armonia con la natura.
examples.en: The people of this village live in harmony with nature.
They lived in harmony with each other.

examples.text: I giapponesi vivono in armonia con la natura.
examples.en: The Japanese live in harmony with nature.
